harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a persistent file-backed LVM volume at /srv/data, grew it online from 1 GiB to 2 GiB without unmounting or altering its contents, and verified recovery after reboot. Ubuntu 16.04.7 and kernel 4.4.0-210 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created a 3 GiB loop-backed LVM physical volume, volume group vgdata, and logical volume lvdata.
Formatted lvdata as ext4 and mounted it read-write at /srv/data.
Created a sentinel file, extended the mounted LV from 1 GiB to 2 GiB, and resized ext4 online.
Configured a systemd service and fstab entry for persistent loop attachment, LVM activation, and mounting.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its new boot identity, recovered mount, LVM state, original data, and read/write operation.

evidence.requirement: Provide a logical volume mounted at /srv/data
evidence.summary: Shows /dev/mapper/vgdata-lvdata mounted read-write as ext4 at /srv/data, both initially and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Grow the volume to at least 2 GB while it remains mounted and contents remain intact
evidence.summary: Shows the mount before and after online growth, LV extension from 1.00 GiB to 2.00 GiB, online ext4 resizing, exact 2,147,483,648-byte size, and identical sentinel SHA-256.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Before and after evidence confirms Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic.
Shows the persistence service enabled and active, fstab configuration present, and successful automatic recovery after reboot.

Baseline boot ID was 225ffbf7-477b-4e25-bbae-e26343dd98bd; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is b71a6601-9c11-4c00-ad4c-4fd5e27031b0; post-restart evidence confirms the active 2 GiB LV, mounted filesystem, preserved sentinel and pre-restart probe, plus a successful post-restart write/read probe.

attempts.summary: Created a persistent file-backed LVM volume at /srv/data, grew it online from 1 GiB to 2 GiB without unmounting or altering its contents, and verified recovery after reboot. Ubuntu 16.04.7 and kernel 4.4.0-210 remain unchanged.
